# netrain

> Matrix-style network packet monitor with real-time threat detection. DDoS/port scan detection, terminal visualizations, built in Rust.

netrain is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/netrain/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/netrain): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
cargo install netrain
```
